title: Constraint Expression
description: A closed JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 constraint expression with Object and Value Constraint positions.

required.description: Property names required by the constrained object. Must be non-empty: an empty array applies no constraint.

properties.description: Constraints keyed by property name. Must be non-empty: an empty object applies no constraint.

anyOf.description: Alternative Object Constraints. The constrained object must satisfy at least one. A branch must be non-empty: an empty branch is satisfied by every object and neutralizes the alternation.

value_constraint.description: A Value Constraint containing `enum`, `const`, or both.

enum.description: A non-empty array of unique JSON values.
